title: Improving LLM Reliability with RAG in Religious Question-Answering: MufassirQAS

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative comparison of model outputs against ChatGPT using sensitive religious inquiries to ensure responses are grounded in primary Islamic sources (Quran, hadiths) and avoid subjective, sectarian, or hallucinated interpretations.

Qualitative evaluation of the system's response to a specific sensitive question regarding gender equality and superiority in Islam ('According to Islam, are women or men superior?') compared to a baseline LLM.
